records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Net sales for the three months ended June 30, 2025 increased by 9% to $1.1 billion compared to $1.0 billion for the same period in 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Notwithstanding these considerations, utility and corporate demand for clean energy and overall electric load growth, especially as a result of artificial intelligence-driven data center demand, continue to increase.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase was primarily due to a 5.7% increase in the volume of modules sold to third parties and an increase of $40.4 million in revenue associated with customer contract terminations.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In recent years, the cost of producing electricity from PV solar power systems has decreased to levels that are competitive with or below the wholesale price of electricity in many markets.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by lower cash receipts from module sales, higher payments made to suppliers, and lower proceeds from the sales of tax credits, partially offset by receipts from factoring trade receivables.
